The most recent election in which a Republican won the New York gubernatorial vote was **George Pataki’s re‑election in 2002**.  
Pataki’s first election to the office was in **1994**. On the ballot in 1994, Pataki was listed on three party lines:

| Party Line | Source |
|------------|--------|
| Republican | “Candidate: GP George Pataki and Betsy McCaughey • Ballot lines: **Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now**” – New York State Board of Elections, 1994 general‑election results |

Thus, when Pataki was first elected as governor in 1994, he ran under the **Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now** lines on the ballot.
